subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recognizes the voice of Eldeth and sighs as he dispels the darkness.
source_quote: Zalthir recognizes the voice; it’s Eldeth. Zalthir sighs and dispels the darkness.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth asks, 'Is everyone okay?'
source_quote: “Is everyone okay?”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouts, 'Yes, we’re all fine.'
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “Yes, we’re all fine.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouts, 'I have the egg.'
source_quote: Daz shouts, “I have the egg.”

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek says, 'I seem to have occupied this body.'
source_quote: “I seem to have occupied this body.”

subject: upper levels of the mesa
fact: The upper levels of the mesa are covered in blood and the broken bodies of the derro.
source_quote: The upper levels of the mesa are covered in blood and the broken bodies of the derro.

subject: tunnel entrance
fact: Near the tunnel entrance is a spectator, a creature similar to but different from a beholder.
source_quote: Where Eldeth is, near the tunnel entrance is a spectator, a creature similar to but different from a beholder.

subject: statue of Demogorgon
fact: Zalthir picks up the statue of Demogorgon.
source_quote: there, he picks up the statue of Demogorgon.

subject: journal by Pliinki
fact: Zalthir finds a journal by Pliinki detailing her macabre experiments and fervent beliefs.
source_quote: He finds a journal by Pliinki.

subject: Pliinki's Journal, Day 17 – The Stone of Diirinka
fact: Pliinki writes that the Obelisk's black metal hums with quasi-magical energy, and Thrazgad ore sits 'discarded and forgotten' next to her workbenches.
source_quote: Its black metal hums with quasi-magical energy... It merely sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches.

subject: Pliinki's Journal, Day 25 – The Prince's Gift Arrives
fact: Pliinki writes that the Red Dragon Egg is no mere replacement, but the vessel for her greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon.
source_quote: The Red Dragon Egg! What a marvel!... This is no mere insurance policy; it is the vessel for my greatest creation, a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself.

subject: Pliinki's Journal, Day 38 – Mutagenic Progress!
fact: Pliinki notes that the egg pulses with new life, and she surrounds it with hair, scales, fungi, and precious viscera to create a two-headed wyrmling for Demogorgon.
source_quote: The egg pulses with new life... hair, scales, fungi from the tunnels, and... other, more precious viscera. My goal is clear, a two-headed wyrmling, a perfect "Prince's gift" for Demogorgon, to serve as his mount.

subject: Pliinki's Journal, Day 47 – The Obelisk Responds
fact: Pliinki writes that the Obelisk hungers for more power and will be the instrument of ascension to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.
source_quote: It hungers for more power, more chaos! This monolith will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.

subject: Pliinki's Journal, Day 54 – Anticipation and Destiny
fact: Pliinki writes that the egg’s dual-headed presence is forming, and the Obelisk will herald the Prince’s arrival and the 'genocidal war' to cleanse the city.
source_quote: The egg is nearing its time!... The Obelisk, too, senses the coming shift. Its purpose... is to herald the Prince's arrival and the "genocidal war" that will cleanse this city.

subject: Letter 1: From Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki informs Uskvil that the Gray Ghosts delivered the egg as planned, and the Thrazgad ore remains 'discarded and forgotten' next to her workbenches.
source_quote: The Obelisk... It refuses to accept the material so far, stubbornly sitting "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches.

subject: Letter 2: From Aliinka to Pliinki
fact: Aliinka confirms the successful retrieval of the dragon egg and Thrazgad ore, and notes that the city spirals precisely as planned.
source_quote: Uskvil confirmed the successful retrieval of both the dragon egg and the Clan Thrazgad ore, as ordered. The city spirals precisely as we planned...

subject: Letter 3: From Pliinki to Uskvil
fact: Pliinki expresses frustration that the Thrazgad ore has proven useless in mending the Obelisk’s fractures.
source_quote: That acid-resistant ore from the Thrazgad Clan... has proven useless in mending its cracks. It still sits "discarded and forgotten" next to my workbenches.

subject: Letter 4: From Narrak to Pliinki
fact: Narrak writes that the Obelisk, once repaired, will be the instrument of ascension to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.
source_quote: This ancient monolith, once repaired, will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.

subject: baby dragon rattle
fact: Thorin finds a giant baby rattle made by Clan Thrazgad.
source_quote: It says made by clan Thrazgad.

subject: alcove in the northeast corner
fact: Zalthir picks up the statue of Demogorgon in the alcove in the northeast corner.
source_quote: Zalthir jumps off the mesa and heads to an alcove in the northeast corner. There, he picks up the statue of Demogorgon.

subject: northwest corner desk
fact: Zalthir finds a journal by Pliinki at a desk in the northwest corner.
source_quote: he heads to the northwest corner where there is a desk with some papers. He finds a journal by Pliinki.

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The group adopts the name 'The Ember Vanguard' after Thorin proposes it, and all members agree.
source_quote: I have it - The Ember Vanguard. ... The Ember Vanguard, Onwards!

subject: Diirdeklin the Derro
fact: Diirdeklin, a Derro guard, lets The Ember Vanguard pass after hearing a Drow Archmage summon a meteor swarm and declaring their name.
source_quote: The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!” Diirdeklin... shouts, “Yes, pass!”

subject: Diinarnnmyr the Derro
fact: Diinarnnmyr mutters that the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue the Derro.
source_quote: Diinarnnmyr mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz uses dancing lights to intimidate the Derro, and his friends congratulate him.
source_quote: Daz is very pleased with his use of dancing lights and the effect it had on the Derro. His friends congratulate him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalls the temple teaching: 'To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.'
source_quote: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum declares, 'We shall return the egg to Gartokkar.'
source_quote: “We shall return the egg to Gartokkar,” he declares.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir mutters, 'I vote we get out of here as discreetly as possible, creating the least amount of chaos as possible.'
source_quote: Zalthir mutters, “I vote we get out of here as discreetly as possible, creating the least amount of chaos as possible.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum proposes giving the egg to Gartokkar and using him to escape, claiming the Derro didn’t steal it but another group did.
source_quote: I’ve been taking notes on all of the deals we have made. And it seems to me that the best choice we have is to give the egg to Gartokkar and then use him to escape from Gracklstugh. We tell Gartokkar that the Derro didn’t steal the egg, but some other crazed group.

subject: double doors
fact: The Ember Vanguard approach a pair of double doors guarded by a squad of derro.
source_quote: As they leave the cave, they choose not to circle back the way they came... which leads to a pair of double doors. In front of those double doors is a small squad of derro.

subject: Drow Archmage
fact: A Drow Archmage summons a meteor swarm and declares The Ember Vanguard’s name to Diirdeklin.
source_quote: He sees a Drow Archmage who has summoned a meteor swarm. The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!”

subject: Empty-Scabbard Killers
fact: Zalthir fears the Empty-Scabbard Killers may want to kill them, prompting their alternate escape route.
source_quote: The Empty Scabbard Killers might want to kill us.

subject: Gray Ghosts
fact: The Gray Ghosts delivered the Red Dragon Egg to Pliinki, unaware of its true purpose.
source_quote: The Gray Ghosts delivered it!... Your operatives, those foolish Gray Ghosts, delivered it precisely as planned...

subject: Stone Guard
fact: Captain Blackskull of the Stone Guard searches for 'corruption', unwittingly aiding the Cult's agenda.
source_quote: Captain Blackskull of the Stone Guard, in her own misguided paranoia, is actively searching for "corruption", unwittingly aiding our efforts to sow discord.

subject: Deepking
fact: The Deepking remains blissfully unaware of his vulnerability, his paranoia and edicts exploited by the Cult.
source_quote: The Deepking remains blissfully unaware of his true vulnerability... His increased reliance on the Empty-Scabbard Killers... serves our purpose.

subject: Narrak
fact: Narrak, the Cult Leader, believes the Obelisk and the egg will enable the conquest of Gracklstugh and its offering to Demogorgon.
source_quote: This ancient monolith, once repaired, will be the instrument of our ascension, allowing us to conquer Gracklstugh and deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.

subject: Aliinka
fact: Aliinka, of the Council of Savants / Gray Ghosts, confirms the city’s destabilization is proceeding as planned.
source_quote: The city spirals precisely as we planned, preparing for the true glory that awaits it.

subject: Uskvil
fact: Uskvil, Master Thief and leader of the Gray Ghosts, acquired Thrazgad ore for Pliinki’s Obelisk project.
source_quote: Narrak mentioned you were assisting with its application to the Obelisk. It refuses to accept the material so far...

subject: Thrazgad Clan
fact: The Thrazgad Clan produced the acid-resistant ore used in attempts to mend the Obelisk, and also crafted the baby dragon rattle.
source_quote: The Thrazgad ore... made by clan Thrazgad.

subject: Gartokkar
fact: Gartokkar desires a genocidal war against the derro, which the Cult manipulates to serve their own ends.
source_quote: The 'genocidal war' against the derro that Gartokkar so desires will merely be the first cleansing.

subject: Errde
fact: Errde is consumed by 'conspiracy theories' and hunts phantoms, aiding the Cult’s deception.
source_quote: Errde's "conspiracy theories" – it's all part of the spiral.

subject: Keepers of the Flame
fact: The Keepers of the Flame are distracted by the loss of the egg, unaware it is destined to serve Demogorgon.
source_quote: The Keepers of the Flame are utterly distracted by the loss of the egg, a secret they guard jealously from the Deepking.

subject: Demogorgon
fact: Demogorgon is the Prince of Demons to whom the egg and Obelisk are destined as sacrificial gifts.
source_quote: a gift worthy of Demogorgon himself... to serve as his mount... to deliver it as a sacrificial gift to Demogorgon.

subject: Bahamut
fact: Bahamut is the deity whose teachings on freedom and choice guide Grygum’s moral dilemma.
source_quote: the power of Bahamut... the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.

subject: Diirinka
fact: Diirinka is the ancient figure who hid the Obelisk, revered by Pliinki as the source of its power.
source_quote: Hidden here by Diirinka himself, I am certain... By Diirinka's Fractured Stone, Pliinki

subject: Themberchaud
fact: Themberchaud is the dragon whose revenge Grygum believes will be unleashed when the egg hatches.
source_quote: the dragon Themberchaud will have its revenge on those who would think to control it.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is deceased, contributing to the group’s emotional hesitation about leaving Gracklstugh.
source_quote: the loss of Buppido, and the death of the derro... have made the idea of leaving Gracklstugh a smouldering inferno less appealing.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth nearly died, influencing the group’s resolve to act cautiously.
source_quote: the near death of Eldeth have made the idea of leaving Gracklstugh a smouldering inferno less appealing.

subject: Pliinki
fact: Pliinki is the mad cultist whose experiments and journals reveal the plot to weaponize the egg and Obelisk against Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Pliinki's Journal... detailing her macabre experiments and fervent beliefs.

subject: Derro
fact: The Derro are the victims of a planned genocidal war, manipulated by the Cult and Gartokkar.
source_quote: the broken bodies of the derro... genocidal war against the derro

subject: Duergar
fact: The Duergar are the oppressors of the Derro, whose Thrazgad ore is exploited by Pliinki’s Cult.
source_quote: the bondage of Duergar... Thrazgad Clan... Duergar

subject: Drow
fact: The Drow of Menzoberranzan are revealed as The Ember Vanguard, using fear and power to pass through Derro territory.
source_quote: a powerful raid by the Drow of Menzoberranzan. The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard...”

subject: The Ember Vanguard adopts their name
fact: The group formally adopts the name 'The Ember Vanguard' after Thorin proposes it and all members agree.
source_quote: I have it - The Ember Vanguard. ... The Ember Vanguard, Onwards!

subject: Zalthir dispels darkness
fact: Zalthir dispels the darkness after recognizing Eldeth’s voice.
source_quote: Zalthir sighs and dispels the darkness.

subject: Grygum declares intent to return the egg to Gartokkar
fact: Grygum declares they will return the egg to Gartokkar to break the Cult’s control and affirm Bahamut’s ideals.
source_quote: “We shall return the egg to Gartokkar,” he declares.

subject: The Ember Vanguard passes Derro guard post
fact: The group is granted passage by Diirdeklin after a Drow Archmage summons a meteor swarm and declares their name.
source_quote: The Drow shouts, “We are The Ember Vanguard, and you will let us pass!” Diirdeklin... shouts, “Yes, pass!”

subject: The group chooses alternate escape route
fact: The group avoids the original path due to fear of the Empty-Scabbard Killers and takes a tunnel leading to double doors.
source_quote: As they leave the cave, they choose not to circle back the way they came... which leads to a pair of double doors.

subject: Thorin finds the baby dragon rattle
fact: Thorin discovers a giant baby rattle made by Clan Thrazgad, engraved with its origin.
source_quote: Thorin shouts, “Look what I found.” ... It says made by clan Thrazgad.

subject: Daz uses dancing lights to intimidate Derro
fact: Daz employs dancing lights to frighten the Derro guard squad, enabling nonviolent passage.
source_quote: Daz is very pleased with his use of dancing lights and the effect it had on the Derro.

subject: Grygum recalls Bahamut’s teaching on freedom
fact: Grygum remembers the temple’s lesson that true freedom lies in breaking another’s dark design, even when madness fuels it.
source_quote: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride... To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.”

subject: Zalthir and Grygum debate the fate of the egg
fact: Zalthir advocates for minimal chaos and stealthy escape; Grygum insists on returning the egg to Gartokkar to defy the Cult’s control.
source_quote: Zalthir mutters, “I vote we get out of here as discreetly as possible...” Grygum declares, “We shall return the egg to Gartokkar...”

subject: The group formulates escape plan using Gartokkar
fact: Grygum proposes telling Gartokkar the Derro didn’t steal the egg, and using his authority to escape by threatening to change their story under torture.
source_quote: We tell Gartokkar that the Derro didn’t steal the egg, but some other crazed group. We also explain that we need his help to escape because of the deal we made with the Stone guards and that if Errde were to imprison us, we might be compelled to change our story under torture.

subject: Thorin suggests the name 'The Ember Vanguard'
fact: Thorin proposes the name 'The Ember Vanguard' to replace their identity as mere adventurers, and the group accepts it.
source_quote: I have it - The Ember Vanguard. ... The Ember Vanguard, Onwards!

subject: Diinarnnmyr misinterprets the Drow incursion
fact: Diinarnnmyr believes the Drow are now allied with the Duergar to subdue the Derro, despite their true nature.
source_quote: Diinarnnmyr mutters, “The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!”

subject: The group reaches double doors guarded by Derro
fact: The Ember Vanguard arrive at double doors where a squad of Derro stand guard, and Daz advises against attacking.
source_quote: In front of those double doors is a small squad of derro. “Do we attack?” Daz turns to him, “No.”
